subject.title: feat(ios): redesign Control tab to a flatter, card-based layout

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this flatter Chat/Talk card layout for the iPhone Control tab after the branch is refreshed and proven against current main?
rationale: The code change is a default visual direction for a primary iOS tab, and the current maintainer comment asks for proof before deciding whether to land that design.

options.title: Require refreshed proof first
options.body: Keep the PR paused until it is rebased, keeps current navigation, fixes the typography issue, and includes matching before/after screenshots for maintainer design review.

options.title: Sponsor the card direction
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly own the card-based Control layout and ask for the mechanical refresh/proof before merge.

options.title: Close in favor of native list baseline
options.body: Maintainers can decide that the current native List-style Control hub is the preferred direction and close the card redesign path.

recommendation.title: Require refreshed proof first
recommendation.body: Keep the PR paused until it is rebased, keeps current navigation, fixes the typography issue, and includes matching before/after screenshots for maintainer design review.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is assigned on this PR, requested the exact proof needed, and recently carried adjacent iOS Control visual changes through merge.
